policy: Every sampled candidate was read against its cited source text. Candidates absent from `exceptions` were judged supported and keep their part-A state. Exceptions move second_passed -> needs_review only; this pass never sets accepted or rejected, so the designated human reviewer still owns every queued item (CONTRACT.md 'Review states').

reason_codes.alight_not_stated: Alight point is not stated as a drop-off in the cited text.
reason_codes.alight_inferred: Alight point inferred from a general route description rather than a stated drop-off.
reason_codes.board_place_not_a_place: Board field holds a mode token rather than a boarding location.
reason_codes.direction_text_mismatch: Direction text describes a different leg than the one recorded.
reason_codes.incomplete_connection: Cited text does not establish that the vehicle reaches the recorded endpoint.
reason_codes.question_premise_unconfirmed: Record comes from the asker's own premise and no answer confirms it.
reason_codes.ride_fields_from_question_only: Cited comment supplies none of the ride fields; they come from the question alone.
reason_codes.walk_text_adds_unsourced_duration: Paraphrase asserts a duration absent from the cited text.
reason_codes.fare_open_range_as_exact: Source gives an open lower bound; recorded as an exact amount.
reason_codes.fare_approximate_as_exact: Source qualifies the amount as approximate; recorded as exact.
reason_codes.fare_hedged: Source marks the amount as uncertain.
reason_codes.fare_unscoped: Amount is attached to no ride, so its scope cannot be checked.
reason_codes.fare_discount_scope_lost: Amount is a discounted fare recorded without its scope.
reason_codes.fare_conditional_compressed: Regular and promotional amounts collapsed into one range, losing the condition.
reason_codes.fare_is_route_total: Amount is an end-to-end route total, not a single reported segment.
reason_codes.fare_cross_comment_scope_unclear: Amount cited in one comment is attached to a ride described in another.
reason_codes.hours_text_adds_unsourced_detail: Paraphrase adds a claim absent from the cited text.
reason_codes.hours_linked_to_wrong_ride: Statement concerns a different service than the linked ride.
reason_codes.hours_ambiguous_clock_resolved: Source clock value is ambiguous; extraction resolved it without support.
reason_codes.hours_hearsay_in_question: Time relayed as hearsay by a commenter who is asking whether it is true.
reason_codes.hours_hedged_mode_mismatch: Hedged time, and the paraphrase names a mode different from the linked ride.
reason_codes.hours_scope_upstream_terminal: Time applies to departure from an upstream terminal, not the recorded boarding point.
reason_codes.question_premise_as_hours_fact: Asker's premise recorded as an hours fact with a concrete clock field.
reason_codes.hours_guess_hardened: Explicitly guessed time recorded as a concrete clock field.
reason_codes.hours_two_values_in_days_text: A second clock value was packed into the days field; needs splitting into two reports.
